JVNDB-2026-000089
Multiple vulnerabilities in GROWI
Overview
GROWI provided by GROWI, Inc. contains multiple vulnerabilities listed below:
Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in the bookmark folder APIs (CWE-639) - CVE-2026-53620
Incorrect authorization in the bookmark listing APIs (CWE-863) - CVE-2026-68951
CVE-2026-53620
Masashi Kawamoto reported this vulnerability to JPCERT/CC, and Fumito Otake of The Japan Research Institute, Limited. reported the same vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.
CVE-2026-68951
GROWI, Inc. reported this vulnerability to JPCERT/CC to notify users of its solution through JVN. JPCERT/CC and GROWI, Inc. coordinated under the Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
GROWI, Inc.
GROWI v8.0.0 and earlier
Impact
An authenticated attacker could retrieve, tamper with, and/or delete the other user's bookmark data (CVE-2026-53620).
An unauthenticated attacker could retrieve the other user's bookmark data (CVE-2026-68951).
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version. The developer has released the following version to address these vulnerabilities.
GROWI v8.0.1
